title: Agent Bazaar v0.3 publication through accepted-offer records
description: Structural projection of the normative C1-C6 contracts. Offers issue qualified own promises; candidates identify exact promise provenance. No execution, payment, delivery or assessment state is defined. Structural validity does not verify cryptography, capability, authority, current status, clocks or protocol semantics.

suite_uri.description: Selected existing proof profile in a real deployment. It must authenticate exact record content, issuer and scope; self-declared metadata is insufficient. Example URIs are unimplemented placeholders.

self_offer_origin.description: Only an initiating offer may use this marker, avoiding a circular self digest. record_id must equal the containing offer ID, and its originator/principal/coordinator must equal the authenticated issuer. Later records use a normal content reference to this complete initiating offer.

selected_options.description: One or more complete compatible options, subject to their selection constraints. Direct acceptance of a single offered option does not require a reciprocal offer record.

own_promises.description: Selected qualified action descriptions, each attributable to its own promiser. Candidate authorship alone does not issue another participant's promises. Bilateral assent does not require a second substantive service promise or another reciprocal obligation.

principal_refusal_windows.description: Exactly one entry per distinct principal identified by the two candidate participants. The agents may share a principal. Uniqueness is by principal_id, not whole-object equality; cross-record coverage and authenticated identity require verification beyond JSON Schema.

adopted_own_promise_ids.description: IDs of this authenticated adopter's qualified actions in the exact candidate. Adoption may confirm already-issued own promises or issue requested own actions at adoption, without a reciprocal offer. An empty list means assent without issuing a substantive performance promise; the adoption still requires its capability and authority evidence. It never issues another actor's promises.
